Herbal House

London

Herbal House found the perfect solution with the ultra-elegant Quell 4 Person Charcoal model, complete with a full furniture set, for their sleek atrium area. This choice provided them with a quiet meeting space that beautifully complements their already modern and contemporary designed open-space work environment.

Alibaba Hangzhou Office

Hangzhou, China

Expanding their Hangzhou office, Alibaba benefited greatly from our office phone pods and meeting booths solutions. Perfectly incorporated design and placement provided the perfect environment for departmental meetings and training sessions that required focus. With ten pods installed on the existing floor, Alibaba's teams now enjoy enhanced productivity and privacy. Our collaboration with the building service manager and security ensured a seamless integration, considering every detail to meet their specific needs.

Zipline Drone Production Office Area

South San Francisco, California

Zipline experienced significant benefits from incorporating two meeting pods and a solo pod into its workspace. These pods have greatly enhanced employees' ability to focus, provided a peaceful, yet modern environment for thoughtful work, and boosted productivity. During client calls, the pods ensure employees can perform their tasks accurately, and in meetings, they facilitate effective collaboration and valuable employee input.

Boeing Singapore Office

Singapore

Since introducing a Meeting Pod from Soundbox, the Boeing Singapore Office has seen significant improvements in productivity and engagement during meetings, events, and training sessions. The pod provides an ideal collaboration space that seamlessly fits into the office design, where employees can focus without distractions from outside noise, making interactions more productive, engaging, and memorable.

ByteDance all branches

ByteDance Ltd has experienced the most productive, comfortable, and seamless collaboration using our meeting pods. These pods have enabled their teams to meet effectively with individuals across time zones, countries, and continents. The airy feel is enhanced by window vicinity placement for maximum enjoyment.

Starbucks Office

Shanghai, china

Starbucks chose our Meeting Pods to ensure optimal productivity and privacy for their meetings. Featuring stylish, modern designer furniture, flexible configurations, and state-of-the-art technology, these pods provide a quiet and efficient environment for any work session or one-on-one discussion.

Huawei Tech all branches

China

Huawei found that our Meeting Pods greatly enhanced their team dynamics. These pods are perfect for meetings, presentations, and brainstorming sessions, providing an ideal environment for improved rapport, communication, and collaboration. The casual setting of these beautiful, bright Meeting Pods has significantly boosted their team's ability to work together more effectively, and kept the spacious feel of the office area.

LG Corporation

Seoul, South Korea

LG's commercial sales department faced challenges with a chaotic office environment, characterised by noisy sales executives on the phones. Seeking a solution to enhance focus, they turned to our medium Zoom Room/Focus Pods. After evaluating partitioning costs and considering ceiling height and residual value, the management team chose our pods. This smart investment transformed their workspace, providing a dedicated environment for focused sales calls and effective training sessions. This change significantly improved productivity and created a quieter, more organised office atmosphere. They truly reclaimed focus!

Volve Cars Belgium

Ghent, Belgium

Sizable, suitable for people. Anmobility allows the.m The requirement for engineers to be on the factory floor, yet needing a workplace for focus, was proving difficult for Volvo - Gent. In addition, the need for flexibility as the production line expands and diversifies was also a requirement. The installation of our sizeable Creative Pod 3-4 person was a great success; an optional mobility pack was purchased, meaning they can move the booth within 5 minutes to any location around the production floor.

Tencent Holdings's all branches

China

Tencent’s new breakout area project has greatly enhanced its meeting spaces. With the addition of three medium-sized pods, featuring two corner sofas and table options, booth accessories, the staff and HR management department now enjoys open and relaxed meetings. This setup has significantly improved their ability to conduct one-on-one staff and HR management sessions in a comfortable and inviting environment.

Premium Acoustic Soundproof Office Pods, Meeting Rooms and Phone Booths

Soundbox offers advanced acoustic soundproof office pods, meeting rooms, Zoom rooms, and phone booths. Designed with sustainability, safety, and impeccable design in mind, they level up your business and offer premium service to your clients.

Our frames showcase a blend of engineering and aesthetics, recognisable for high-end features and distinguishable qualities unlike any bulky alternatives in the market.

Our philosophy

Partnering with professionals from different industry sectors to deliver consistent, reliable, and competitive acoustic control, insulation, and damping solutions. We are in the business of inspiring and opening up a new era of infinite possibilities within the industry.

Our mission

As Europe's acoustic solution leader, we're dedicated to providing comfortable, sustainable soundproof pod and booth environments that foster productivity.

Let's talk

10 years in the making

With a state-of-the-art manufacturing facility in Europe, we've spent 10 years perfecting our sound booth solutions. From mature markets to emerging ones, our innovative Zoom rooms and phone booths enhance productivity and acoustic control.

Environmental Responsibility

Pioneers in using recycled carbon plastic, Soundbox Store champions a low-carbon footprint approach. Each Soundbox booth boasts a:

  • Carbon footprint of ≤0.071kg Co2e
  • Energy consumption average of ≤0.4MJ
  • Air acidification level of ≤0.0001kg SO2e 
  • Water eutrophication of ≤0.00002PO4

Affordable Sound Solutions

At a fraction of the cost of traditional construction, our pre-fab solutions create additional space for focused work and collaboration without constant noise, interruption, and distraction.

Plug & Play Installation

Our revolutionary product design allows you to move the panels anywhere you wish. Carefree!

Adaptable Design

Unlike traditional constructions, our purpose-built Pods were designed to adapt to your workspace and can easily be positioned in various places throughout your office, or in an entirely new location.

No Renovation Needed

The breakthrough in product design & process means you pay less for the same results.

Hearing Protection

We specialise in architectural acoustic environments, construction, and industrial noise control. Acoustic environmental safety technology and solutions.

Time Saving

Streamlined design for quick installation. Let our professionals assist you, or use our clear instructions and videos.

Still riding the high from @clerkenwelldesignweek ✨🌿 What a week — a vibrant celebration of creativity, connection, and conversation. From “Forecasting the Future of Workplace Design” to “The Importance of Biophilia”, every moment sparked inspiration on how we shape the spaces that shape us. Huge thanks to the incredible minds who shared their vision: ✨ Michaela Reysenn of @kai.interiors , who brought bold and human-centric design thinking to the conversation. ✨ Mary Sholl, whose insights offered a fresh perspective on sensory-led spatial innovation. ✨ Harriett Burton of @nova_space_interiors, who introduced future-forward approaches to workplace interiors. ✨ Katie Le Chevalier representing @planteriagroup, who championed the importance of biophilic wellbeing in design. ✨ @mariaolivainteriors, whose creative direction and innovative ideas enriched the dialogue. And a massive thank-you to everyone who came by — your energy made it unforgettable. #ClerkenwellDesignWeek #CDW25 #WorkplaceDesign #BiophilicDesign #InteriorDesignUK #DesignInspo #CreativeCommunity

It began with four walls, exposed brick, and the echo of possibility. 6th March — the keys in hand, the space empty but full of promise. We walked the floors, sketched ideas in the air, imagined how it might all come together. Then came the noise — drills, ladders, sawdust. Mornings of decisions, evenings of adjustments. By 25th April, it was scaffolding and chaos. Tools everywhere. The floor wrapped in plastic, timber going up, and our nerves stretched thin. We were chasing a finish line that felt just out of reach. 20th May arrived like a shot. The electrician was still fitting lighting that morning. Furniture landed. Crates opened. Labels peeled. The kind of opening-day energy you only feel once. And then… the doors opened. You came. Old friends, new faces, curious minds, and kind words. The space filled with life — with conversation, laughter, and connection. It was no longer just a showroom — it became something shared, something meaningful. A space that embodied biophilia, beauty, wellness, and calm. A clear reflection of our vision for resimercial design in 2025. To everyone who stopped by, supported, encouraged, or simply showed up — thank you. You made it real. #ClerkenwellDesignWeek #CDW2025 #WorkplaceDesign #InteriorDesign #DesignJourney #Resimercial #BiophilicDesign #Teamwork #Transformation
